regions.construction: Project all vertices of the verified convex closed shared glass PLY through the fixed pinhole camera. Test pixel centers against the projected convex hull. Signed Euclidean raster distance defines interior/rim/exterior; no rendered pixels are read.
regions.semantics: Geometry-only labels, not segmentation of refracted smoke. Background can still contain caustics/shadows; it is not an error-free control. Tent edge filtering crosses the center-defined silhouette.

acquisition.sampler: PBRT paddedsobol/fastowen, engine frozen sampler; equal seed labels across backends are independent estimators, not paired random streams.

intake: Require normal renderer exit, completed receipts, exact EXR dimensions128x128 or512x512 and finite linear RGB. Engine actual metadata must equal targetSPP, seed, maxdepth and dimensions.
Verify current or explicitly archived frozen source/binary/shader/assets hashes; never accept unguarded changed source by path alone. Preserve actual launch hashes and limitations of outer guards.
Verify host medium belongs to actual glass mesh draw, IOR1.5, transmission1, roughness0, pure-boundary=false and air-contributor=false; density transform identity and native stored bbox.
Smoke/clear geometry, camera, film, optical interface, lights and medium binding identical; densityScale only. Preserve raw RGB and all four seed EXRs.
Shader validation and white calibration are prerequisites, not substitutes for scene transport matching.

mean_gate.estimator: For each backend/seed/region/channel compute the spatial mean in float64; average four whole-run values. Difference = engine mean minus PBRT mean. No per-renderer normalization and no fitted exposure.
mean_gate.CI: Union of independent-backend Welch t interval and 20000 percentile whole-run bootstrap interval. Backend bootstrap counts independent; pixels not resampled as independent observations.
mean_gate.practical_band: max(0.003,0.02*abs(PBRT region/channel mean)) in linear radiance units, frozen definition.
mean_gate.PASS_SCOPED: For every nonempty primary region and everyRGB/Y channel at1024SPP, the full two-sided95% differenceCI is inside [-band,+band].
mean_gate.FAIL: At least one95% differenceCI is wholly outside its band; retain diagnostic figures.
mean_gate.INCONCLUSIVE: Other cases, including CI overlapping a band boundary. Mean zero-in-CI is reported separately; a CI excludingzero but insideband is not proof of unbiasedness.
mean_gate.multiple_comparisons: Intervals are marginal95%, not simultaneous familywise95%. No global confidence probability is claimed. The all-regions rule is an engineering screen.

noise_gate.estimator: Float64 per-pixel sample variance ddof1 across four seeds. Spatial average within each geometry region, separately RGB channel andY; also whole-run region-mean variance.
noise_gate.within_backend_spp_pairing: Resample the same seed indices at low/highSPP; repeated checkpoints share random streams.
noise_gate.gate: For each backend separately, all nonzero-observed region/channel endpoint1024/64 variance ratios have one-sided95% upper bound<1. Adjacent256/64 and1024/256 are diagnostics. Zero variance is NOT_EVALUABLE, not PASS.
noise_gate.cross_backend: Report engine/PBRT variance ratio and independent-backend95% bootstrapCI at everySPP. No mandatory ratio≈1: spectral sampling, light selection and tracking estimators legitimately have different variance. An unexplained large ratio remains a limitation and motivates a targeted efficiency control.
noise_gate.spectral_scope: PBRT wavelength jitter contributes noise; no attempt to subtract it using the unit-white scene because path-dependent sample correlation can differ.

depth_gate.estimator: Within each backend pair identical seed labels for maxdepth32 and64 at1024SPP, using region means. Bootstrap counts paired byseed, union with paired-t95% interval.
depth_gate.gate: Entire95% depth64-minus32CI lies within band in everyregion/channel. Otherwise preserve32 results and classify truncation as unresolved; do not claim the depth32 cross-backend residual is a renderer bug.
depth_gate.scope: If depth64 is not run, depth adequacy is PENDING and overall numerical acceptance remains OPEN. No assumption that32mustsuffice for glass/TIR.

visual.primary: Side-by-side actual RGB mean4 at128, same-seed128 andhero512 rawRGB images. One fixed common exposure1, Reinhard x/(1+x), then standard sRGB transfer; negatives only clamped for display and counted/reported in raw numerical diagnostics.
visual.SSIM: Report common-display SSIM diagnostically with fixed settings; no SSIM threshold selected after viewing images, and no SSIM-only transport PASS.
visual.hero: Single seed at2048SPP is display evidence only; no independent-run variance or95%CI. Do not combine it with pilot four seeds or treat higherSPP prefix as an extra independent run.
visual.human_review: Stage3 representative image review still required; Stage2 test-scene visual review was waived, not approved.

performance.control: Same glass/geometry/lights/camera; densityScale0 clear control vs.18 smoke.
performance.recording: Retain exact cumulative engine checkpoint timing scopes and PBRT whole child process scopes. Concurrent CPU calibration is excluded from performance judgment.
performance.comparison: For causal slowdown, run isolated one-shot smoke/clear at identical resolutionSPPdepth and compute within-renderer paired/median ratios. Compare ratios between renderers cautiously; never relabel CPU wall time as pure GPU or compare raw seconds with different scopes.
performance.stage4: This protocol prepares measurement; no slowdown evidence is produced here.

nonacceptance: Known unresolved boundary/transport source defect invalidates an overall numericalPASS even if engineering bands fit. Record exact current source status rather than inherit an obsolete issue.
A source/model mismatch cannot be repaired by a statistical band, fitted exposure, image crop chosen from residuals, or replacing the source scene silently.
Do not loosen thresholds after observing data. Any new protocol version needs a written source/measurement rationale, preserves this version and reruns its declared analysis.
root_review_note: Accepted unchanged numerical bands and geometry masks. Root saw only excluded low-SPP composition previews; no formal cohort was rendered or analyzed. V4 lighting changes preserve camera/geometry/masks. No image-derived exposure or source correction is used.
scope_note: Acceptance is limited to rendered contracts and their tested numerical robustness. General nonmanifold/vertex contacts, unproven transform rounding, and sub-epsilon finite-interval transport are not certified.

installation_path_update.reason: lighting_v3 changes installed scene identities and mesh paths only; numerical gates, acquisition, geometry ROI, white calibration and physical settings are unchanged.
